name: Breakthrough by Tony Robbins
description:
"Why live an ordinary life when you can live an extraordinary one?" For over 4 decades, Tony Robbins has helped over 50 million people from 100 countries create real and lasting change in their lives.

Through events, coaching and training programs – including Ultimate Edge, the #1 personal development program of all time – Tony's clients have created life changing breakthroughs in business, productivity, health and personal fulfillment.

Now his audio and video courses are available instantly, on your smartphone or tablet, to listen to anytime, anywhere.

• Access over 100 hours of curated, original content in a step-by-step, easy-to-use format

• Be coached and guided by Tony himself, as he walks you through his proven training systems for personal improvement

• Interrupted, or need a break? Use the resume function to pick up right where you left off

Discover what millions before you have gained from learning Tony Robbins' strategies and tools. Learn how to change your mindset, improve your energy & vitality, deepen your relationships, influence & lead, and design your ideal life.

name: Ozlo Sleepbuds
description:
Ozlo Sleepbuds® 2 are tiny, ultra-comfy earbuds designed to give you the best sleep of your life. They come with all-night battery life, noise blocking, audio streaming, and biometric sensing.  

The Ozlo app allows you to personalize your Sleepbuds experience, with controls for all your important settings and reports for your sleep data.  

LUXURIOUS COMFORT 
Sleepbuds are surrounded with super soft, squishy silicone tips for unparalleled all-night comfort, even for side sleepers. And they're specifically designed to be low profile, so they don't stick out causing undue pressure on your ear like other earbuds.  

LONG BATTERY LIFE 
Sleepbuds can play for up to 14 hours for all-night noise masking or streaming. The Smart Case can provide 2-3 additional charges so you can take it with you anywhere you go.  

SOUND, DESIGNED FOR SLEEP 
Sleepbuds come with precisely tuned sound that helps to reduce the impact of disruptive noise like snoring, traffic, pets, and noisy neighbors.  

BLUETOOTH STREAMING 
Your bedtime routine, your way. Stream music, podcasts, audiobooks, and soundscapes that help you relax before falling asleep.

PERSONAL IN-EAR ALARM 
Sleepbuds private in-ear alarm gently wakes you through your Sleepbuds instead of filling the room with sound.

SLEEP MODES 
Choose how your Sleepbuds transition into your Sleep Sound throughout the night. Whether you prefer it to start immediately, after a timer, when you fall asleep, or after streaming ends, there’s a mode that fit

name: Vision Board & Goal Tracker

Bring your dreams to life with our app, Vision Board - Aesthetic Quote. 

Create a visual representation of your goals and aspirations with our intuitive and user-friendly Vision Board and Affirmation maker . 

Features include the ability to create your vision board, save it to your camera roll, set as a widget, add inspiring quotes, and add images to enhance the aesthetic appeal of your board. 

With our new feature create and customize beautiful affirmations that resonate with your personal style. Browse a wide selection of uplifting affirmations and effortlessly customize their design, from the font and color to the background. Best of all, you can add your personalized affirmations directly to your home screen or widget, empowering you with positivity every time you unlock your phone.

Our app allows you to explore and discover your mood, interests, dreams, and turn them into a manifestation of your aspirations. You can attract positive energy into your life by setting intentions and focusing on what you truly want.

With Vision Board - Aesthetic Quote, you can easily create a beautiful and inspiring vision board and affirmations that serves as a constant reminder of your goals and dreams.

Don't wait any longer, download Vision Board - Aesthetic Quote today and start manifesting your dreams into reality.
